title: Wife, husband 58: crushing chest pain, sweating, pain into both arms

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 4410 Anza Street. It's my husband, he's 58.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He has crushing pain in his chest, he's sweating a lot, and the pain is going down both arms.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's awake, he's breathing fast, he says it feels like an elephant on his chest.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is he talking to you normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's talking, he's just really scared and pale.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About fifteen minutes ago, when he was getting dressed.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Have him sit down and stay still.
